KIDDO.SCHOOL

A little school of possibility.

Make · Learn · Discover.

Learning you can get your hands on

Kiddo.school is a growing collection of hands-on ideas for curious children and the adults learning alongside them. This first collection brings together ten activities across art, science, nature, maths, stories and engineering.

More curiosity, less perfection

A crooked collage, a bridge that bends or a seed that has not sprouted can all begin a useful conversation. The aim is to notice, try, question and make something your own.

Simple and open to explore

The pilot is free to browse, with no account required. Each activity has a materials list, practical steps, age adaptations and an optional original image sheet. The collection includes original cartoon illustrations and printable image sheets.
